text: It was great to hear from you, and congratulations on getting the interview! Of course you can stay with me – I’d love to see you.

The spare room’s free that week, so you can stay as long as you like. I’ll make sure there are clean towels and some breakfast for you, and you’re welcome to use my desk if you need to prepare anything the night before.

Getting here is easy. When you arrive at Central Station, take the number 12 bus from outside the main entrance and get off at Park Lane – it takes about fifteen minutes. My flat is in the blue building opposite the bus stop, on the second floor.

As for the interview itself, I’d leave early, because the traffic in the city centre can be terrible in the mornings. Why don’t we do a practice run the evening before? I could ask you a few typical questions, and then go out for dinner to help you relax.
Let me know what time your train gets in, and I’ll meet you at the stop. Can’t wait to see you!

note.en: A consequence: the room is free, so the friend can stay.
Moves to the last point: the interview.
The next step of the evening plan.

strengths.en: Contractions, exclamations and “Why don’t we…?” make it sound like a real letter to a friend.
strengths.kk: Қысқартулар, лепті сөйлемдер, «Why don’t we…?» — досқа жазылған нағыз хат сияқты.
strengths.ru: Сокращения, восклицания, «Why don’t we…?» — звучит как настоящее письмо другу.
strengths.example: Why don’t we do a practice run the evening before?

strengths.en: The bus number, stop, journey time and building colour — you could really follow these directions.
strengths.kk: Автобус нөмірі, аялдама, уақыт, үйдің түсі — осы сипаттамамен жетуге болады.
strengths.ru: Номер автобуса, остановка, время, цвет дома — по этому описанию можно доехать.
strengths.example: take the number 12 bus from outside the main entrance

strengths.en: The friend asked to stay, and the answer comes in the first paragraph.
strengths.kk: Дос қалуға бола ма деп сұрады — жауап бірінші абзацта.
strengths.ru: Друг спросил, можно ли остаться, — ответ в первом абзаце.
strengths.example: Of course you can stay with me

strengths.en: The advice has a reason: “because the traffic … can be terrible”.
strengths.kk: Кеңес жалаң емес: «because the traffic … can be terrible».
strengths.ru: Совет не голый: «because the traffic … can be terrible».
strengths.example: because the traffic in the city centre can be terrible

note.en: A friend, by first name: informal.
A warm start and an immediate answer to the request: “Of course you can stay”.
note.kk: Жылы басталу және өтінішке бірден жауап: «Of course you can stay».
note.ru: Тёплое начало и сразу ответ на просьбу: «Of course you can stay».

note.en: Bullet 1: yes, with details that make the invitation real.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — иә, және шақыруды шынайы ететін деректер.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — да, и детали, которые делают приглашение настоящим.

note.en: Bullet 2: the route step by step — station, bus, stop, building.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — жол қадаммен: вокзал, автобус, аялдама, үй.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — дорога по шагам: вокзал, автобус, остановка, дом.

note.en: Bullet 3: advice and an offer to help, in a friendly way — “Why don’t we…?”.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — кеңес және көмек ұсынысы, достық үнмен: «Why don’t we…?».
note.ru: Пункт 3 — совет и предложение помочь, по-дружески: «Why don’t we…?».

note.en: A request for the arrival time and a cheerful ending.
note.kk: Уақытты хабарлауды сұрау және қуанышты соңы.
note.ru: Просьба сообщить время и радостная концовка.

note.en: Informal: “Best wishes” and just a first name.
